content.text: I thoroughly enjoyed your piece on ███████████. My nephew, Steven ██████ played at Vandy while Bakich was coaching there and absolutely loved the guy. I’ve known and respected Tim Corbin for quite a while and was able to introduce Gardy to him while we were in Omaha. Hard to root against either of these two coaches but I hope to see Bakich this summer at Comerica showing off the Wolverines newly acquired National Championship Trophy.  See you when you return.
